description: A single 303-style acid bass voice — wavetable saw or square oscillator, ladder filter with an envelope-modulated cutoff, and a slide circuit — played entirely from outside.

params.text: Sets the filter cutoff, 314Hz at the bottom of the travel to 2394Hz at the top.
Sets how far the decay envelope opens the filter above the cutoff.
Sets the decay time of the filter envelope, 200ms at the bottom of the travel to 2500ms at the top.
Sets the gain feeding the filter, one to two times, which is what saturates the ladder.
Sets how far an accent lifts the amplitude envelope and opens the filter.
Sets the filter resonance; the knob is squared and scaled to 0 to 10, so the ringing arrives in the last part of the travel.
Detunes the oscillator by up to ±700 cents, on a squared curve so small movements near the centre are fine.
Sets the output level; past 75% the audio is pushed into a saturation rather than getting louder.
Chooses saw or square for the oscillator, and writing either one overwrites the Blend slider on the menu.

inputs.text: Shifts the filter cutoff by 1V per octave, applied before the envelope is added.
Modulates the envelope depth, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt, added to the knob.
Modulates the decay time, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt, added to the knob.
Modulates the drive, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt, added to the knob.
A gate above 1V accents the note, which cuts its decay to 200ms and lifts the envelope; the module reads this jack as a gate and not as a level, despite the panel grouping it with the CV inputs.
Detunes the oscillator, ±5V for the full ±700 cents, added to the FINE knob; the manual gives this as ±1V.
Modulates the output level, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt, added to the knob.
Sets the oscillator pitch at 1V per octave, 0V giving C4 at 261.63Hz.
A gate above 1V starts a note and holds the envelope open; the note releases when it falls.
Above 1V the pitch glides into the new note instead of stepping to it, over the time set by Slide Time on the menu.

notes: Nothing sounds until a gate above 1V arrives at GATE; a pitch at CV on its own starts no note.
The module computes nothing at all while OUT is unpatched.
The display shows the name and the value of the last knob you turned.
The display shows a tick against CV and against GATE while those jacks are patched, and a face instead while SLIDE is patched, with eyes that widen as the VCF knob rises.
menu: VCF Range — under Expert Mode, shifts the span the VCF knob covers, from 314Hz-2394Hz at the top of the slider down to 100Hz-760Hz at the bottom
Decay Speed — under Expert Mode, multiplies the rate the envelope decays at: 4 times in the middle, 6 times at the bottom of the slider and 2 times at the top
Sustain — under Expert Mode, sets the level the envelope holds at while the gate is high; 0% is the 303 behaviour and the default
Release — under Expert Mode, sets how long the envelope takes to fall once the gate ends, 21ms to 500ms
Blend — under Expert Mode, crossfades the oscillator between saw and square; the panel switch overwrites it
Slide Time — under Expert Mode, sets the glide used while SLIDE is high, 0 to 100ms with a floor of 10ms; it comes up at 37.5ms
Bass Comp — under Expert Mode, moves the filter's feedback highpass between 150Hz and 500Hz, which sets how much low end the resonance cancels
